title: Spiritual Enlightenment (miniquest)
start: Talk with Ling on the south beach of Aminishi.
prereq_other: Complete the 'Meet the Assassin' voyage in player-owned port

recommended.t: High level armour, weapons, and food. Enemies are weak to air spells

kills.t: Several Sotapanna, Sakadagami, and/or Anagami (level 111, 118 and 124 respectively)

rewards.t: Access to Aminishi's Spirit Realm and arhat dragons

steps.t: Charter a ship to Aminishi and talk to Ling. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: If you have just completed Impressing the Locals, you may need to relog for the chat option to show up.

steps.t: Kill creatures on the island until you receive 3 books.

sub.t: Ordered from best drop rate to worst, kill Anagami, Sakadagami or Sotapanna.
Pick up some spirit dragon charms because you will need 1-2 later. (Note: Ensure to have toggled off your spirit imp destroy option)

steps.t: Enter The Well of Spirits on the middle tier to travel to the spirit realm.
Head south-west and talk to Yulong on the shore. He is exactly where you would find Ling outside the spirit realm. [Chat: Any]

get_inside.text: Aminishi teleport - Players may break this teletab to teleport to The Assassin on Aminishi. It can be purchased at Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes, or from Bryll Thoksdottir's Elite Dungeon Reward Shop for 1000 dungeoneering tokens.
Players can travel to Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals.
Players can travel to the temple by using the teleport chest from the Shadow Reef and Dragonkin Laboratory
